title: dacrydium papuanum
intro: Dacrydium papuanum, commonly known as the Papuan daisywood or Papuan conifer, is a species of evergreen coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. It is native to Papua New Guinea and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dacrydium papuanum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, helping to reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and diterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
